So, you want to know which replicas are the greatest bang for your buck, eh? Well have no fear, this guide will help you with that. We're going to start with the absolute lowest tier and then go all the way to UA's. All the prices are rough estimates, if it's 52 dollars it's still going in the 50 dollar category

$50

Alright, you're wondering what you can do with about 50 bucks, now that may not seem like a lot of money for a nice pair of sneakers at first glance, but you can find tons of great stuff in this price range, stuff that is very accurate and very well put together. Here is what you can get:

NIKE ROSHE RUN REPS

Roshe Run replicas are generally pretty great. Most of them only have two real flaws they are quite minor in the grand scheme of things. The back heel loop and the loop on the tongue are too small. I picked up a pair of replica Yeezy Roshe Run reps which resell for a decent amount, and have never been called out. They're pretty great.

SELECT AIR MAX REPLICAS

Air Max replicas are generally pretty damn good, since the real ones are made in the same city as the replicas. Other than printed ones (things like the Atmos Duck Camo) and ones like the Independence Days, they're usually pretty accurate. I linked the OG Air Max up top since there are really no flaws on the pair that I have and I highly recommend them.

DUNKS

Another one of those shoes where it's select ones that are pretty great. You can find some on point Dunk SB Lows or High's if you do a bit of research. Obviously if you order a pair of the Nike Dunk 'Air Angry Birds' they're gonna come out looking not that great, but you can certainly find some awesome steals in the dunk category.

JEREMY SCOTT'S

Talked about quite often around these parts, Jeremy Scott reps are absolutely the coolest bang for your buck kicks out there. Often super accurate, these reps are the best for those who are trying to ball on a budget. For example, I got these three pairs for 150 dollars [7] . Also, here [8] is a review I made that shows how great these replicas actually are. Honestly these are my favorite reps for about 50 dollars, and will surely break necks wherever you go.

NIKE BASKETBALL SHOES

You can find more than decent pairs of KD's, Kobe's, Lebrons etc. for around 50 dollars. Now of course, these shoes won't be real basketball shoes and I wouldn't exactly recommend balling in any of them. They look pretty good aesthetically (like the Kobe 8 Galaxy's or most of the KD6's) but they will fall apart when put to performance wear.

More than $100

This is when you start getting into things like Super Perfect shoes for Jordans and some baller runners, like dope Asics and New Balances. Note that I did not include any AAA Jordans in this guide, I don't like them at all and tbh I think they just look shitty and that it's better to save for an SP than buy an AAA.

SUPER PERFECT JORDANS

Super Perfect Jordan's are great for those who want the Jordan look and want to stay in a budget at the same time. The best SP's available are 4's, 6's, and 12's. Here is a small excerpt taken out of the beginner's guide by /u/TheMagicTractor : "Super Perfect - These are essentially Perfects with all the fixes, making them much closer to authentic look and quality. For around $100 you get a shoe that is more or less flawless. A few details are likely to be off." Although these shoes aren't truly flawless, they will look great from a distance at least, but upon closer inspection they will be flawed, obviously flaws vary from shoe to shoe, but mostly have jagged tongues and shittier construction. Also SP Jordan's with carbon fiber will have a fake plastic imitiation instead.

ASIC GEL LYTE SERIES

I can't stress enough how much I love Asics. When it comes to the silhouette, these shoes are on point and most of them also have the correct colors as well, looking almost retail. Things like the GL3 Salmon Toes that resell for hundreds of dollars can be had for about 80 shipped, which is a steal of a price. Some shoes are slightly off in color (like the GLV Sage and Volcano) but these are a major bang for your buck line of replicas. You can search the subreddit for some pics of Gel Lyte replicas and I have confidence that you will not be disappointed with what you find.

FLYKNIT REPLICAS

Flyknit materials are usually on point, and super comfortable. You can see the quality of the construction here is pretty damn good. I've had them since October and they've been holding up amazing. The sole seems a bit more bulky than retail but I don't mind at all. Flyknit replicas are definitely good quality. I was going to make Kobe 9's their own category but I'm not going to since they are also essentially just a pair of Flyknits, they are also quite decent.

NEW BALANCE REPLICAS

Honestly these are dope, the quality on them is superb, refer to the Repsneakers YouTube channel to see a video of them on foot and an in depth review.

SUPREME AF1 REPLICAS

Definitely some decent replicas for the price compared to resell value, the sole is a bit bulky and there are some lettering problems in the back but these are certainly some decent reps.

Y-3 QASA

They're very good replicas for the price, 90% on point with retails. On the highs, tongue are a bit shorter. Now with the black/black colorway, make sure your supplier gets the correct version with etched "Yohji Yamamoto" on the side. Qasa Racers also only have one flaw, the tongue being shorter; and a caution to those looking for white Qasa racers, the white plastic panels on the side are yellowed on most pairs. The black c/w is on point though.

$150

Ah, we are now approaching Super Max Perfect territory, the focus of this entire section. SMP Jordans are ridiculously on point. Although they are not made in the same factories or even the same city as real Nike shoes, the majority of them are insanely on point. Usually using the same materials as the actual Nike shoes, these shoes are pretty awesome.

SUPER MAX PERFECT JORDANS

Now, pretty much all of the SMP Jordan's are really on point, but the ones you definitely want to get (even over UA in a lot of cases) are 4's and 6's. Honestly, a lot of them are retail. Fear 4's and Infrared 6's both are ridiculously sick and are examples of how great SMP shoes can be. Also, all SMP shoes with carbon fiber do indeed have real carbon fiber.

Super Max Perfect Yeezy's

Alright, well SMP Yeezy's are a huge centerpiece to this subreddit, and there are two pairs that you can cop for 150. You can cop the Solar Red's and you can cop the Red October's. I'm not going to sit here and explain the flaws to you, since there are literally over 50 reviews of these types of shoes on the subreddit. Use the search bar if you want to learn some more about these shoes. I know this is technically cheating, but you can cop Super Max Pure Plats for about 189.

Ballin' Level, $175-350

This is when you reach the UA's. 9/10 of these shoes look basically identical to retail. These will run you anywhere from 175-350 Dollars depending on the rarity and hype of the shoes. UA Air Jordans will usually cost you between 175-200, Unauthorized Yeezys go from about 300-350, and personally I do think it's purely because of the hype factor. Unauthorized Louis Vuittons go from 236 to 339, (236 for Dons, 339 for Jaspers).

If you're still curious or confused, feel free to PM me or just ask the question publicly on the subreddit, If you want to contribute or make some edits to this post, write it in the comments and I'll add/edit the original post. Hope this helps!
